svg.title: Supported tools in Ofox Desktop
svg.desc: Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT Codex mode, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Gemini CLI, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek Harness and Pi. This is an integration list, not an endorsement or equal-feature claim.
svg.text: Native integrations. Capabilities vary by tool, version, and platform.
ChatGPT refers to its Codex mode. Product marks belong to their respective owners.
